summary: We lend drills, ladders and saws to renters who cannot buy them. The grant would replace two worn-out table saws and pay for a safety workshop series for first-time borrowers. Last year we served 410 households with two volunteers.

A weekly after-school chess club for ages 8-14. Funds would buy 20 tournament sets and clocks and cover entry fees for a regional tournament. No staff, no venue plan yet, and no budget breakdown beyond the total.
We want to turn a vacant lot across the bay into a vegetable garden with raised beds and a rain barrel system.
